description.text: In near-total darkness, an empty showroom floor recedes into depth, its polished surface almost black and its far edges lost to shadow. The

rests low and wide, a faint silhouette whose carbon fibre body catches only a thin, broken sliver of reflected light along one flank. The surrounding space remains swallowed in dark, so the car's outline, the long floor plane and the hush of the room are the only readable forms. No other objects or people occupy the frame; the darkness feels dense and close, with the faint highlight implying a hard, cool source just outside the visible area. The car's wheels sit planted, its nose aimed into the open floor, and the quiet stillness holds until the first hint of motion. A low sheen on the floor mirrors the barest edge of the body, but the cabin, grille and wheel faces stay submerged in black.
The showroom is almost entirely dark; the
is visible only as a low silhouette and a single reflected edge highlight.
A low engine idle hum sits under the silence of the showroom.

pulls forward across the showroom floor, leaving the deepest shadow behind as it rolls into a narrow band of light. Its carbon fibre body gathers a long specular highlight along the flank and hood, the surface shifting from a matte silhouette to a legible black finish with a visible weave. The front of the car advances toward the viewer while the empty floor opens ahead and the darkness falls back behind the rear quarters. The motion is smooth and deliberate, tyres crossing the polished surface with a soft roll, and the car's low, wide stance stays planted as the light reveals the contour of the body. The reflected highlight travels with the movement, catching the leading edge first and then stretching back along the side as the car clears the shadow. As the nose reaches the lit zone, the dark floor behind it dims again, and the body's black panels hold a wet-looking gleam without losing the deep, carbon-wrapped texture.
eases forward out of the deepest shadow, its front end entering the light.
The engine note rises gently as the tyres roll over the polished showroom floor.
A long specular highlight travels along the carbon fibre body as the car becomes fully legible.

soundscape: A near-silent showroom air, a low engine idle hum, then a gently rising engine note and tyres rolling over the polished floor.
